name: CloudPay
summary: CloudPay sells managed global payroll for companies paying staff in anywhere from five countries to 50, with in-country legislation experts and one interface for pay data from every country. It publishes no price, and the page points to a contact form.

facts.text: CloudPay's payroll page says its solutions suit companies whether they manage employee pay in five countries or 50, and gives no exact country count in readable text.
The page describes end-to-end compliance with in-country legislation experts.
A Local Payroll Information capability consolidates all global pay data into a single interface, with real-time reporting through customizable dashboards.
The page names four HCM partners: Workday, Oracle, HiBob and SAP SuccessFactors, and says the only contract is with CloudPay.

hiddenCosts: No price is published. The page offers Talk to us and Contact us links only.
Contract length, setup fees and per-country charges are not stated on the page.

contract.cancellation: The page says your only contract is with CloudPay. It states no length or termination terms.
